name: ContentProtection
description: Content-protection read path for FreeInk: OCF encryption.xml scan and decrypt-on-read for protected EPUBs, given the content key. Parser-agnostic (works with CrossPoint's Epub or FreeInkBook). Books stay encrypted at rest; decryption is on-read into memory. Opt-in crypto backend via -DFREEINK_CONTENT_WOLFSSL=1 plus a wolfSSL lib_dep.
notes: Inflate provider: define CONTENT_EXTERNAL_MINIZ to bind to the host application's already-linked miniz (no second copy in the image); omit it to compile the vendored content_-prefixed copy for standalone host tests.
